title: That One Karen Who Thinks She's a Lawyer
description:
This sovereign citizen was driving without a seatbelt and proper license plate while refusing to identify herself to the officer. She had pending felony warrants from Colorado so it’s obvious why she wouldn’t want to identify herself. The female’s car was impounded and seized for investigation against the licence plates but it didn’t sit well with the owner. The female was charged with No Valid Operators License without Identification, refusal to give Information to or Cooperate with Officer, Resisting Arrest, Operating a Motor Vehicle without Insurance, Failure to renew expired registration over two months, and failure to wear safety belt.
